text: Could you make this pic look like a still from a 1970s movie? I’ve always had a soft spot for the way old movies feel like memories. Please keep her recognisable and keep the square framing. I’m thinking warm faded colours and film grain for that movie look. I’m excited to see how this photo feels with that bit of nostalgia. No text, please.
